retrievalProfile.description: A vibrant Y2K-era techno aesthetic featuring a blurred molecular structure over a grainy yellow-to-blue gradient with technical line-art overlays.
triggerTerms: rounded square logo frame with technical lines

recipe.visualDefinition: A central, highly blurred orange molecular structure with five radiating nodes set against a noisy, diagonal yellow-to-teal gradient. The composition is framed by thin grey technical lines and a prominent rounded square container in the upper right containing bold, sans-serif alphanumeric characters.
coreVisualRelationships: Blurred organic central form vs. sharp geometric technical lines
Warm orange focal point vs. cool teal corner gradient
Grainy texture vs. smooth color transitions
coreInvariants: Heavy Gaussian blur on the central orange node structure
Fine-grain noise texture across the entire canvas
Thin, horizontal and vertical grey technical hair-lines
Rounded square frame with a thick grey border in the upper quadrant

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: A large, blurred orange molecular shape occupies the center, scaled to fill approximately 60% of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: A rounded square frame in the top-right corner containing bold blue text.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the bright orange center, move to the sharp typographic box in the top right, and follow the thin horizontal line across the left edge.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The yellow and teal gradient background provides open space, though textured with noise.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Bright yellow and orange for the primary background and central subject.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Teal and blue in the bottom-left corner and within the typographic elements.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Medium grey for technical lines and framing elements.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the center fading into a desaturated, grainy teal at the periphery.

characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'K' has a short, thick leg
The '5' features a large, circular bottom bowl
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single bold display face paired with technical line graphics.
graphicDevices: Vertical bar-code style lines on the left edge

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy weight and rounded terminals.
Standard rounded sans-serif with similar proportions.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a grainy yellow-to-teal diagonal gradient. In the center, place a highly blurred orange shape resembling a central circle with five smaller circles connected by thick, blurred lines. Add thin grey horizontal lines and a vertical bar-code pattern on the left.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a rounded square with a thick grey border in the top right. Inside, place bold, rounded blue sans-serif text with a thin grey outline.

verificationChecks: Is the central orange shape sufficiently blurred?
Is there a visible grain/noise texture across the image?
Is the text contained within a rounded square frame?
Are the technical lines thin and precise?

adjustableVariables: Blur intensity of the central molecule
Color of the corner gradient (teal vs. purple)
Thickness of the rounded square border
mustRedesign: Exact placement of technical line clusters

avoid: Sharp edges on the central molecule

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the orange shape does not have sharp edges.
Verify the presence of the rounded square frame in the top right.
Check that the background gradient includes both yellow and teal tones.
Confirm the grain texture is uniform across the composition.
recipe.reuseFormula: Y2K Techno = (Blurred Organic Subject + Grainy Gradient Background) * (Sharp Technical Line Overlays + Rounded Square Framing)
